name: First Valentine
source:
Forced to marry a monster, you're surprised to find that the "monster" you're set to marry is actually the God of love, Cupid. However, when you found out his secret he ran from you. Now, you are on a journey to find your husband. 

[From [url=https://madizzy-studios.itch.io/first-valentine]itch.io[/url]]
